subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Down Syndrome, a genetic condition that can be associated with intellectual disability and characteristic physical features, results from:

options.option_text: The presence of an extra copy of chromosome 21

explanation: Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21) is a genetic condition caused by an extra copy of chromosome 21 — unrelated to nutrition, infection, or teaching quality.

subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A child who struggles to sit still, is easily distracted, and frequently interrupts others despite normal intelligence may be showing signs of:
explanation: Inattention, hyperactivity and impulsivity, despite typical intelligence, are core ADHD indicators — distinct from intellectual disability (broader cognitive delay) or sensory impairments.

subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Universal Design for Learning (UDL) is a teaching framework that:

options.option_text: Provides multiple means of representation, engagement and expression so ALL learners, including those with disabilities, can access content
Designs lessons for only the most academically advanced students
Requires every child to learn in exactly the same way
Applies only to children without any disability

explanation: UDL builds flexibility into curriculum design from the start (multiple ways to present, engage, and demonstrate learning) so it works for the widest range of learners, including those with disabilities — not a one-size-fits-all approach.

subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: A screen-reader software that converts on-screen text to speech is an example of:

options.option_text: Assistive technology for learners with visual impairment
A tool used only by teachers, never by students
A tool with no educational application

explanation: Screen readers are assistive technology enabling learners with visual impairment to access digital text independently — part of the broader toolkit of accommodations for inclusive education.
